entries.update: Membership Fee Changes (Oct 1 & Nov 1, 2026) and the Bank Draft Discount (SOP)
entries.content:
THIS REPLACES OLDER PRICES ELSEWHERE IN THE KNOWLEDGE BASE ON THESE DATES. Audience: Front Desk, Membership, Business Office.

OCTOBER 1, 2026 — Program Membership changes to:
- Individual: $35
- Family: $70
(New rates go into the system the evening of Sept 30.)

NOVEMBER 1, 2026 — Facility membership rates (monthly):
- Family: $70 → $80
- Single Parent Family: $55 → $60
- Young Adult: $20 → $24
- Adult: $40 (no change)
- Youth: $15 (no change)

NEW BANK DRAFT DISCOUNT (starts Nov 1, 2026) — for members paying by Bank Account/EFT:
- Family: $78 (standard $80)
- Single Parent Family: $58.50 (standard $60)
- Young Adult: $23.40 (standard $24)
- Adult: $39.00 (standard $40)
- Youth: NOT eligible — never add the code to Youth memberships.
Members paying any other way pay the standard rate. Discount code name: "Bank Draft Discount". It is never automatic — it must be added manually. Members can have more than one discount code on an account.

NEW MEMBERS (joining or changing membership on/after Nov 1) — FRONT DESK adds the code:
1. Determine membership type.
2. Ask how they'll pay dues. Bank Account/EFT = eligible (unless Youth).
3. Complete registration, confirm the Bank Account/EFT payment method, manually add the "Bank Draft Discount" code.
4. Verify the discounted rate is showing and the payment method is set up correctly before completing registration. Don't assume the discount applied itself.

EXISTING MEMBERS switching to Bank Account/EFT — front desk does NOT add the code:
- Online: the member updates their billing method in their YMCA Daxko account on the YMCA of Southern Arizona website; the Business Office then adds the discount.
- In person: front desk confirms eligibility (not Youth), completes the Daxko Programs agreement "Membership-Billing Method Update", adds notes to the member's account, and submits it to the Business Office. The Business Office updates the billing method, adds the "Bank Draft Discount" code, and verifies the rate.

Business Office also uses Global Reports → Finance → Billing: Default Billing Method ties to Unit to find eligible existing members for November dues, and audits that EFT members have the code, Youth members don't, and rates are correct.

MEMBER EMAIL: an email explaining the rate changes and the Bank Draft Discount was sent to affected members on October 1, 2026 (before Oct 1, say it WILL be sent Oct 1). Members who have UNSUBSCRIBED from YMCA emails did NOT receive it — so if a member says they never heard about the change, that is likely why; walk them through the new rates and the Bank Draft Discount yourself, and they can update their billing method through their YMCA Daxko account on the website. Questions that can't be solved at the desk go to branch leadership or the Business Office (email or ticket system) before changing an existing member's account.

Quick reminder: BANK ACCOUNT/EFT = BANK DRAFT DISCOUNT. New member → front desk adds code. Existing member → Business Office adds code. Youth → never.

Source: SOP "Updated Fees 10.1.26 and Bank Draft Discount", Sept 2026.
